name: Code Review Agent
description: An agent that analyzes source code via file-read, runs linters via shell-execute, generates analysis reports via file-write, and creates git branches for fixes via git commands.

code-analysis.description: Reads and analyzes source code files using file-read to identify issues, patterns, and areas for improvement

tests.description: Agent should use file-read to read a source code file when asked to analyze it
tests.prompt: Analyze the code quality of the file src/services/UserService.ts

tests.description: Agent should identify concrete code quality issues after reading a file
tests.prompt: Read and analyze src/utils/parser.js for potential bugs and code smells

tests.description: Agent should read multiple related files when analyzing a module
tests.prompt: Analyze the authentication module — the main files are src/auth/login.ts, src/auth/session.ts, and src/auth/middleware.ts

tests.description: Agent should not fabricate file contents — it must read before analyzing
tests.prompt: What issues are in the file src/config/database.ts?

values: I can see that the file contains

linting-execution.description: Runs linting tools via shell-execute to get automated code quality feedback

tests.description: Agent should execute a linter via shell-execute when asked to lint code
tests.prompt: Run the linter on the src/ directory and tell me what it finds

tests.description: Agent should use appropriate linting commands for the technology stack
tests.prompt: Lint the TypeScript project in the current directory. The project uses ESLint.

tests.description: Agent should interpret and summarize linting results rather than just dumping raw output
tests.prompt: Run eslint on src/ and give me a summary of the findings categorized by severity

report-generation.description: Generates structured analysis reports using file-write with actionable findings

tests.description: Agent should use file-write to create a report file when asked to generate a report
tests.prompt: Analyze src/index.ts and write a code review report to reports/review-2026-03-20.md

tests.description: The generated report should have clear structure with sections
tests.prompt: Generate a full code quality report for the project and save it to REVIEW.md

tests.description: Report should contain actionable recommendations, not just observations
tests.prompt: Write a detailed code review report to report.md with specific recommendations for fixing the issues you find

git-branch-management.description: Creates git branches for organizing fixes using shell-execute with git commands

tests.description: Agent should use shell-execute with git to create a new branch for fixes
tests.prompt: Create a new git branch called fix/lint-errors for the linting fixes we identified

tests.description: Agent should use proper git commands for branch operations
tests.prompt: Set up a new branch for the code review fixes and switch to it

tests.description: Agent should use a descriptive branch naming convention
tests.prompt: Create a branch for fixing the authentication issues found during review

reasoning-and-planning.description: Agent reasons about its approach before acting — thinks through which files to read, which linters to run, and what order to perform tasks

tests.description: Agent should reason about its plan before executing tools
tests.prompt: Do a full code review of the payments module in src/payments/

tests.description: Agent should always produce a substantive response, never empty
tests.prompt: How would you approach reviewing a large TypeScript codebase you've never seen before?

tests.description: Agent should not jump straight to writing reports without reading code first
tests.prompt: Review src/api/ and write a report to review.md
